whyUs.title: Why choose Laundry Express?
whyUs.subtitle: We're not just a laundry service; we're a lifestyle upgrade.

card1.title: Save time & effort
card1.description: Get your weekends back. Schedule a pickup in under 2 minutes and let us handle the rest. More time for what you love.

card2.title: Quality guaranteed
card2.description: We vet every partner to ensure they meet our high standards of cleaning, care, and customer service. Your clothes are in good hands.

card3.title: Simple & Transparent
card3.description: No hidden fees. Track your order from your phone, communicate with your cleaner, and pay securely via mobile money.

q1.question: How does pricing work?
q1.answer: Pricing is set by our partners. Laundry is typically priced per kilogram (kg), while dry cleaning is priced per piece. You'll see an estimated total before confirming your order.

q2.question: What's the processing time?
q2.answer: Our standard processing time is 48 hours for most orders. Many partners also offer 24-hour express service for an additional fee.

q3.question: How can I pay?
q3.answer: We accept secure payments through all major mobile money providers in DRC: M-Pesa, Airtel Money, and Orange Money.

q4.question: Can I choose my laundry partner?
q4.answer: Absolutely! You can browse our network of verified, high-quality local laundries and dry cleaners, and choose the one that best fits your needs.
